blocks.text: Annacis Island Industrial Real Estate — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Where is Annacis Island located and how is it accessed?
Annacis Island is an industrial island in the south arm of the Fraser River within the City of
, connected directly to Highway 91 via the Alex Fraser Bridge to the south and the Queensborough Bridge to the north, with immediate links to Highway 17 and Highway 99.
What kinds of industrial buildings are found on Annacis Island?

Annacis Island features high-cube distribution centres, multi-dock logistics warehouses, light manufacturing plants, cold-storage buildings, and small-to-medium industrial strata units serving Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley.
Are properties on Annacis Island freehold, strata, or leasehold?

Annacis Island includes freehold industrial parcels, strata-titled warehouse bays, and institutional long-term ground leases or investment-held logistics parks. Always check title structure and any registered right-of-way or railway easements before submitting an offer.
What loading, ceiling height, and power specs should buyers verify?

Confirm clear ceiling height under the joists (typically 20 to 32+ feet), dock-level vs grade-level loading doors, trailer marshalling and turning radius, 3-phase power capacity (amps and voltage), ESFR sprinkler systems, and floor-slab load ratings.
Is a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment needed on Annacis Island?

Yes. Commercial lenders require a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) — and a Phase II subsurface check if prior industrial uses warrant it — during due diligence on any Annacis Island purchase or refinancing.
How do I verify permitted uses and zoning on Annacis Island?
Check the property zoning designation under the City of Delta Zoning Bylaw (see
) to confirm whether warehousing, distribution, manufacturing, accessory office, or outdoor storage is permitted on the parcel.
How does Annacis Island compare with Tilbury for warehouse buyers?
